caption: The video captures a dusk street scene where rain is already falling beneath a glowing orange street lamp. The tallest pole stands on the right, its bright fixture casting a luminous cone of fine vertical streaks that shimmer and re-form continuously. A second lit lamp hangs lower and to the left, while a third arm remains unlit in the background. Dark palm fronds crowd the left edge and leafy branches frame the right, with a road sign and a roofline settling along the bottom of the still frame. The showering is already underway on the first frame and persists through the last. Within the illuminated volume, the bright lines appear to fall downward, their density and pattern fluctuating from moment to moment while the overall cone anchored at the lamp stays persistent. The shimmering texture ripples without the cone itself expanding or translating across the scene. The lit lamps remain fixed, and the poles, palm tree, sign and roofline do not shift relative to the frame, indicating a static camera holding on the ongoing rain. No new event interrupts the steady downpour.
relations: Rain passing through the lit cone produces bright vertical streaks that shimmer and re-form continuously.
The lamp fixture anchored to the right pole keeps the illuminated cone fixed while streaks fall downward.
A static camera holds the dusk scene, leaving poles, palm, sign and roofline unmoved.
Ongoing downpour fluctuates streak density moment to moment without expanding or translating the cone.
